Over the past couple of days, as I’ve been testing on-chain interactions, my biggest takeaway is: many projects are still racing for speed, while Newton Protocol has already “installed the brake pads” first. When I first got started on Newton Mainnet Beta with @NewtonProtocol , it doesn’t look flashy at first glance—but the more I run it, the clearer it becomes that it isn’t trying to solve the problem of “having AI click a few buttons for you.” Instead, it aims to make sure that before an AI Agent does anything on-chain, it’s constrained by rules.
I think its most important point is that it breaks a user’s intent into executable, limitable, and traceable actions. For example, authorization isn’t just a one-click “I agree.” The system first checks policy conditions, permission scope, asset-calling boundaries, and the execution path. In simple terms: the Agent can work, but it can’t just touch your wallet at will; it can automate tasks, but it can’t wander around with unlimited permissions. This design is quite realistic in DeFi, because the scariest part on-chain is never that things are slow—it’s that you don’t know whether what you just signed away is a ticket or a property deed.
In terms of hands-on feedback, Newton Mainnet Beta now feels more like an execution-layer testing ground. The focus isn’t on showing off; it’s on validating whether “AI + on-chain permission management” can actually work. It puts policy checks before execution, and with record traceability, it lets users see clearly why each step happened, under what conditions it happened, and whether it went out of bounds. If this mechanism continues to be refined, the room for future expansion—Vault management, automatic rebalancing, policy execution—could be much larger than what ordinary interaction tools offer.
$NEWT  is what’s truly worth watching: not how loud the short-term narrative gets, but whether Newton can turn “review first, execute next, and be accountable” into the default basic configuration for on-chain automation. #Newt  #BTC #ETH

title: Beyond the Breakdown: Why This Crypto Drop Looks More Like a Liquidity Reset Than the Start of a
subTitle:
Bear Market
Tonight the market suddenly collectively plunged, BTC dropped over 3% losing the 62000 mark, ETH fell nearly 4%, and second-tier coins like SOL and ZEC generally dropped over 6%. Market sentiment instantly shifted from consolidation and bottoming to panic.

Many people ask if the market has completely deteriorated. Here's my judgment: this is a breakdown shakeout during the consolidation and bottoming process, not yet a full-scale crash, but the liquidity risk of small coins has already begun to concentrate and explode.
Core logic of the decline: macro + technical factors resonating to drive the sell-off
The strengthening of the US dollar puts pressure on all assets, triggering stop-losses due to technical breakdowns

Tonight the US dollar index rebounded, and gold simultaneously dropped over 2.3%, with most assets generally under pressure. BTC just touched the previous consolidation lower boundary at 62500; after breaking below, it directly triggered programmed stop-loss orders, causing a chain reaction that also crashed secondary coins and altcoins. This is a dual-resonance decline caused by macroeconomic pressure plus technical breakdown, not a crash triggered by a single negative factor. 

2. Withdrawal of existing funds, liquidity risks of altcoins become apparent

Typical characteristics of a stagnant market: mainstream coins drop 3%-4%, secondary coins drop 6%-7%, and illiquid small altcoins plummet directly by 80%. This indicates that funds in the market are withdrawing from small-cap coins and concentrating on top mainstream coins. The coins with weaker fundamentals and less liquidity fall even harder, which is a very typical phenomenon during a bottoming phase. 

3. The long-term fundamentals have not been broken; it is just a short-term emotional release

There has been no large-scale outflow from BTC spot ETFs, and there are no major negative fundamentals in the industry; it is more of a short-term emotional sell-off. The overall pattern of consolidation and bottoming has not changed, but after the lower boundary of the range was broken, it will take time to rebuild the bottom, and the grinding process will be longer.

My operating strategy

BTC

Core support at 61000, strong support at the 60000 round number; upper resistance at 62500, strong resistance at 63000.

Personal strategy: There is strong support around 61000. Those who want to build positions in batches can gradually buy low in the 61000-60000 range. If the rebound to 62500 fails to hold, reduce positions to trade the swing, but keep the base position without selling it off. 

ETH

Support below at 1700, strong support at 1680; resistance above at 1760.

Personal strategy: The trend is weaker than BTC, 1700 is a key psychological level, breaking below it will further test 1680. Spot can be accumulated in batches on dips, avoid heavy short positions in contracts to prevent liquidation from emotional rebounds.

Finally, to be honest

The bottoming process is inherently a repeatedly tormenting phase; breaking below the box does not mean the market is over, it just means the shakeout is more intense. Enduring this repeatedly tormenting stage is the correct way to play the bottoming period.

title: CPI、PPI、PCE、非农每次公布市场都抖三抖——这四个数据到底怎么看？
subTitle:
通胀看CPI、就业看非农——四个数据搞定宏观交易逻辑
非农数据好ETH反而跌？一篇文章搞懂四个最影响盘面的宏观数据

今天不聊K线，聊四个你躲不开的数据——CPI、PPI、PCE、非农。
每次公布，市场都得抖三抖。搞懂它们，你至少能知道市场在慌什么、在赌什么。
CPI——你买东西贵了多少
CPI全称消费者物价指数，就是统计局去超市、加油站、商场统计价格，算出老百姓买东西贵了多少。CPI高了，说明钱在贬值。里面有个“核心CPI”，剔除了食品和能源——这两样价格经常乱跳，剔除之后更能看清通胀的底色。
发布机构：劳工统计局（BLS）。公布时间：每月中旬，通常是第二周。
CPI超预期高 → 通胀顽固 → 美联储不敢降息 → 利空ETH。
CPI低于预期 → 通胀降温 → 降息预期升温 → 利多ETH。

PPI——工厂进货贵了多少
PPI全称生产者价格指数，统计工厂买原材料、半成品花了多少钱。它是CPI的“领先指标”——工厂成本高了，迟早会涨价转嫁给消费者，推高未来的CPI。
发布机构：劳工统计局（BLS）。公布时间：通常CPI发布后的第二天。
PPI高 → 未来CPI可能走高 → 加息预期强化 → 利空ETH。
PPI低 → 未来通胀压力减弱 → 利多ETH。

PCE——美联储自己用的通胀计算器
PCE全称个人消费支出物价指数，和CPI一样衡量物价，但统计范围更广，方法也不同。CPI是“固定购物篮”——牛肉涨价了你还得算牛肉；PCE能反映“替代效应”——牛肉贵了大家改吃鸡肉，PCE能捕捉到这种变化。
美联储认为PCE比CPI更准确，所以把它当作最看重的通胀指标来做决策。
发布机构：经济分析局（BEA）。公布时间：每月月底。
逻辑和CPI一样：高了利空，低了利多。但PCE的分量更重。

非农——美国经济的心电图
非农全称非农就业报告，统计上个月美国非农业部门新增了多少个就业岗位。它直接反映美国经济的健康状况——就业好说明经济强劲，就业差说明经济可能出问题。
发布机构：劳工统计局（BLS）。公布时间：每月第一个周五。
非农的逻辑和通胀数据完全相反：非农超预期（就业强）→ 经济过热 → 美联储可能加息 → 利空ETH。非农不及预期（就业弱）→ 经济放缓 → 降息预期升温 → 利多ETH。

用一张表收尾：
指标：CPI。衡量什么：老百姓买东西的价格。谁发布：劳工统计局（BLS）。公布时间：每月中旬。对ETH的影响：高→利空，低→利多。
指标：PPI。衡量什么：工厂进货的价格。谁发布：劳工统计局（BLS）。公布时间：CPI后一天。对ETH的影响：高→利空，低→利多。
指标：PCE。衡量什么：美联储最爱的通胀指标。谁发布：经济分析局（BEA）。公布时间：每月月底。对ETH的影响：高→利空，低→利多。
指标：非农。衡量什么：新增了多少工作岗位。谁发布：劳工统计局（BLS）。公布时间：每月第一个周五。对ETH的影响：强→利空，弱→利多。

核心一句话总结： CPI、PPI、PCE看通胀，非农看就业。通胀高、就业强 → 美联储可能加息 → 利空ETH；通胀低、就业弱 → 美联储可能降息 → 利多ETH。PCE是美联储最看重的那个，分量最重。

搞懂这四个数据，下次公布的时候，你就知道该往哪个方向看了。

translatedData.title: Every time CPI, PPI, PCE, and non-farm data are released, the market shakes three times—how should you actually read these four data points?
translatedData.subTitle:
For inflation, look at CPI; for employment, look at non-farm employment—four data releases to master the logic of macro trading
Non-farm data comes in strong, yet ETH falls—how can that be? One article to understand the four macro data points that most influence the market’s moves

Today we’re not talking about candlestick charts. Let’s talk about four data points you can’t dodge—CPI, PPI, PCE, and non-farm.
Every time they’re released, the market has to shake three times. Understand them, and at least you’ll know what the market is panicking about and what it’s betting on.
CPI—how much more expensive it is for you to buy things
CPI, the full name being the Consumer Price Index, is the measure the National Bureau of Statistics uses to track prices at places like supermarkets, gas stations, and shopping malls, calculating how much more (or less) expensive it has become for ordinary people to buy things. When CPI is high, it indicates that money is losing value. Within it, there is something called “core CPI,” which excludes food and energy—two categories whose prices often swing wildly. By removing them, you can better see the underlying picture of inflation.

Burning $37 million in a single week—PUMP circulating supply has already been cut by 41.8%

The official weekly report for pump.fun’s first phase is out, and the numbers are quite interesting. From June 29 to July 5, total protocol fees across the three major modules—Bonding Curve, PumpSwap, and Terminal—came to $7.2 million. Of that, 50% of the net fees are used directly for PUMP buybacks and burn. In the past 7 days, the buyback and burn amount was about $3.7 million. So far, a cumulative 41.8% of the circulating supply has been burned.

Let’s break down a few key figures:
1. Bonding Curve’s weekly trading volume was $553 million, while PumpSwap’s was $1.65 billion. PumpSwap is already 3x Bonding Curve, suggesting that post-token-launch secondary-market liquidity is migrating toward PumpSwap.
2. Transaction speed was compressed from 1–2 seconds down to 300–400 milliseconds. The UX improvement is real.
3. After the low-KYC deposit channel went live, daily platform deposit trading volume grew by about 21% on average. This added increment suggests new users are still flowing in.
4. After the GO feature launched, related posts were viewed over 18 million times. About 3,000 bounty tasks were created, with 18,000 submissions and cumulative rewards paid of over $600,000—community activity is indeed strong.

But don’t rush to call it “to the moon.” Burning 41.8% sounds impressive, but the key is that the burn funding source is protocol fees, and protocol fees depend on trading volume. Bonding Curve is $553 million in volume, PumpSwap is $1.65 billion. These are top-tier numbers in the Meme space, but they still fall short by scale compared with established DEXs like Uniswap. If Meme hype cools down later and protocol fees decline, the speed of buyback and burn would slow down in sync.

Outlook: PUMP’s deflationary narrative has short-term support, but at its core it’s a trading-volume-driven flywheel. Right now, the broader market BTC is ranging around 63,100, ETH around 1,770, and sentiment is relatively cautious. As the platform token, PUMP is tightly tied to the overall Meme-trading momentum, so it’s not recommended to bet on it in isolation; it can serve as an observation target for a Meme-ecosystem allocation. The key is whether next week’s trading volume can hold above the $2 billion level—if volume contracts, buyback strength will likely fade as well.

One-sentence summary: The burn data looks great, but the flywheel’s speed depends on trading volume—don’t be hypnotized by percentages.

拆解几个关键数据：
1. 单周 Bonding Curve 交易量 5.53 亿美元，PumpSwap 交易量 16.5 亿美元，后者已是前者的 3 倍，说明代币发射后的二级市场流动性正在向 PumpSwap 迁移。
2. 交易速度从 1-2 秒压缩到 300-400 毫秒，用户体验层面的优化是实打实的。
3. 低 KYC 入金通道上线后，平台入金交易量日均增长约 21%，这个增量说明新用户仍在涌入。
4. GO 功能推出后相关帖子浏览量超 1800 万，已创建约 3000 个赏金任务，收到 1.8 万次提交，累计支付超 60 万美元奖励——社区活跃度确实在。

但别急着喊"起飞"。销毁 41.8% 听着唬人，关键是销毁资金来源是协议费用，而协议费用取决于交易量。Bonding Curve 交易量 5.53 亿，PumpSwap 16.5 亿，这个数据在 Meme 赛道算头部，但跟 Uniswap 等老牌 DEX 比还有量级差距。如果后续 Meme 热度退潮，协议费用下滑，回购销毁的速度会同步放缓。

一句话总结：销毁数据漂亮，但飞轮转速取决于交易量，别被百分比催眠。

title: 🧧 Искали Red Packet? Ловите кое-что покруче — мой разбор ваучера 🎫!
subTitle:
Как бесплатный ваучер на фьючерсы включил во мне аналитика (Мой первый опыт и разбор ошибок).
Хроники одного ваучера: от эйфории до суровой реальности
Все началось с того, что я активировала приветственный ваучер на фьючерсы $ETH / $USDC  с плечом 20X. Моя маржа составляла всего около 1,35 USDC, а цена входа была 1799,98. Сначала кажется: «О, бесплатные деньги, сейчас легко заберу прибыль!». Но крипторынок быстро спустил меня с небес на землю.
Что я поняла о цене ликвидации?
Я вовремя задалась вопросом: как определяется цена ликвидации? Оказалось, это «точка невозврата», когда убыток доедает твой залог. С плечом 20X достаточно падения цены всего на 5%, чтобы позиция сгорела. Моя ликвидация встала на 1707,63.
💡 Главный вывод №1: Биржа никогда не потеряет свои деньги. Большое плечо — это огромный риск, даже если движение на графике кажется незначительным (всего -2% за сутки).
Мой личный теханализ: как я разглядела «пропасть» на графике
Когда $ETH  покатился вниз, я открыла старший 2-часовой график и заметила важную вещь. В начале июля был резкий, безоткатный рост — четыре огромные зеленые свечи. Я поняла: цена оставила за собой пустоту (имбаланс), и сейчас она идет обратно в эту «пропасть», чтобы перекрыть движение.
💡 Главный вывод №2: Рынок цикличен и почти идентичен каждый день плюс-минус. Если цена пробивает локальную полку, она летит закрывать предыдущие пустоты. Мой прогноз оправдался: тренд оказался сильнее, и глупо было надеяться на чудо и пересиживать просадку, если бы это были мои реальные деньги.
Синдром упущенной выгоды (FOMO) на примере $BNB
Параллельно я заметила точно такую же картину на графике $BNB: три волны роста и резкое падение. Появилась мысль: «Эх, надо было вчера активировать второй ваучер на 10 USDT на понижение (Шорт)! Время ушло».
Но вместо того, чтобы поддаться панике и прыгнуть в уходящий поезд, я приняла холодное решение. Раз цена уже долетела до сильной поддержки (566), открывать шорт прямо сейчас — это огромный риск получить отскок в лицо.
💡 Главный вывод №3: Не успела зайти в начале движения — не трогай. Рынок никуда не убежит, будут новые циклы. Главное — сохранить капитал (или ваучер) для понятной ситуации.
Итог моего эксперимента
Даже если мой первый ваучер закроется по ликвидации — я получила бесценный опыт без потери собственных средств. Я научилась читать структуру рынка, понимать риски кредитного плеча и вовремя останавливать эмоции. Теперь мой второй ваучер на 10 USDT ждет своего часа, и его я активирую уже с холодной головой!

💼 EDX Markets raises $76 million in funding—rise of an institutional-grade crypto exchange

Who led the investment?

SBI Holdings—one of Japan’s largest financial services groups and a long-term strategic shareholder of Ripple.

Who is EDX?

Founded by personnel with backgrounds from top financial institutions such as Citadel Securities, Fidelity Digital Assets, and Charles Schwab.

The core model: trading and custody are completely separated.

What does that mean?

Traditional crypto exchanges (e.g., Coinbase, Binance) do both matching (order execution) and custody—one of the root causes behind the collapse of FTX (the coins you have there can be used for business).

EDX separates the two things end to end:
• EDX only performs order matching
• Asset custody is handled by an independent licensed institution
• Settlement is processed through a central clearinghouse to eliminate counterparty risk

This is exactly what institutional investors need—they don’t just need the lowest fees; they need compliant, trustworthy safety.

With SBI Holdings stepping in, the pathway for Japanese institutions to enter crypto has been opened.

Do you think “institutional-grade exchanges” will be the next breakout track?👇

💼 EDX Markets完成$7,600万融资——机构级加密交易所的崛起

领投方是谁？

SBI Holdings——日本最大的金融服务集团之一，也是Ripple的长期战略股东。

EDX是谁？

由Citadel证券、Fidelity数字资产、Charles Schwab等顶级金融机构背景的人员创立。

核心模式：交易与托管完全分离。

这是什么意思？

传统加密交易所（如Coinbase、Binance）同时做撮合和托管——这是FTX崩塌的根本原因之一（你存在那里的币，它可以拿去做生意）。

EDX把两件事彻底分开：
• EDX只做撮合交易
• 资产托管交给独立的持牌机构
• 通过中央清算所结算，消除对手方风险

这正是机构投资者最需要的——他们不需要最低的手续费，他们需要合规的安全感。

SBI Holdings的入场，打通了日本机构进入加密的通道。

你认为"机构级交易所"会是下一个爆发赛道吗？👇

Are institutions out there just buying up everything? Bitmine splashes $71.6 million to buy 40,000 ETH—what are they trying to do?

🐋 Institutional funds are now setting their sights on Ethereum!

According to the latest on-chain data, Bitmine, through FalconX and Kraken, purchased an additional 40,000 ETH in one go, worth approximately $71.6 million.💰

Notably, this transaction wasn’t executed directly on an exchange.
Instead, it was carried out via OTC (over-the-counter trading).

Why do this?🤔
Because if large sums buy on an exchange directly,
it can easily cause sharp price volatility.
OTC is better suited for institutions to build large positions—
allowing them to access liquidity while reducing market impact.📊

From the on-chain records,
🔹 FalconX transferred out 20,000 ETH
🔹 Kraken transferred out 20,000 ETH

And before the official transfer,
there were also small test transactions—
which is a common move by institutional players.👀

More importantly,
this isn’t the first time Bitmine has made a major ETH buy.

Previously, the company had already increased its holdings by more than 40,000 ETH.
Now it’s adding again,
which has also prompted the market to wonder:
Are institutions continuously building positions in Ethereum?📈

Of course, a large transfer alone doesn’t mean a rally will start immediately.

But more and more listed companies are allocating ETH,
which also shows that institutional interest in the Ethereum ecosystem
is continuing to heat up.🔥
